questions.question:
Choose the one-word substitution for:
"A person who dislikes or distrusts humankind in general and avoids society."
questions.explanation: Greek root 'mis-' (hate) + 'anthropos' (human) se 'Misanthrope' banta hai, jiska matlab manav jati se nafrat karne wala hota hai. Philanthropist manav jati ki bhalai karne wala hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question:
Select the single word for:
"A person who is habitually quiet, speaks very little, and is reserved in manner."
questions.explanation: 'Taciturn' aadat se kam bolne wale vyakti ko kehte hain. Loquacious aur Garrulous dono baatuni (very talkative) hote hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question:
What is the correct term for:
"A person who knows and is able to speak or use several languages?"
questions.explanation: Greek root 'poly-' (many) + 'glotta' (tongue/language) se 'Polyglot' banta hai, jiska matlab kai bhashayein bolne wala hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question:
Identify the word that means:
"An expert with refined judgment and critical appreciation in matters of fine art, food, or wine."
questions.explanation: 'Connoisseur' kala, swaad ya fine arts ke parkhi aur visheshagya ko kehte hain. Dilettante sirf shaukia upari ruchi rakhne wala hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question:
Choose the substitution for:
"A person who strongly attacks or challenges established cherished beliefs, traditions, or revered institutions."
questions.explanation: Greek 'eikon' (image) + 'klan' (to break) se 'Iconoclast' banta hai. Ye established roodhiyon aur paramparao ko chunauti dene wala hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question: What is an extreme, irrational dread of being in confined or enclosed spaces called?
questions.explanation: Band ya tang jagahon (confined spaces) ke darr ko 'Claustrophobia' kehte hain. Acrophobia unchai ka darr hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question:
Select the correct term for:
"Strong dislike, contempt, or prejudice against people from other countries or cultures."
questions.explanation: Greek root 'xenos' (stranger/foreigner) + 'phobia' (fear/dislike) se 'Xenophobia' banta hai, jiska matlab videshi logon ke prati durbhavna hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question: Which term describes a recurrent psychological failure to resist urges to steal unneeded items?
questions.explanation: Greek root 'kleptes' (thief) + 'mania' (compulsion) se 'Kleptomania' banta hai. Ye bina aarthik zaroorat ke chori karne ki compulsive bimari hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question:
Choose the word for:
"A person who practices severe self-discipline and voluntary abstention from all worldly pleasures."
questions.explanation: 'Ascetic' tapasvi ya sanyasi hota hai jo physical sukh-suvidhaon ko tyaag deta hai. Hedonist, Epicure, aur Sybarite sabhi pleasure-seekers hote hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: What is the term for a government where complete and absolute power is concentrated in the hands of one single ruler?
questions.explanation: Greek 'auto' (self/one) + 'kratos' (power) se 'Autocracy' banta hai, jiska matlab ek vyakti ka taanashahi shasan hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.subtopic: Government: Rule by Priests or Religious Law
questions.question:
Identify the word for:
"A system of government where state authority is held by religious figures and laws are based on divine tenets."
questions.explanation: Greek 'theos' (god) + 'kratos' (rule) se 'Theocracy' banta hai. Isme dharmik niyam aur dharm-guru shasan chalate hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.subtopic: Government: Absence of Law and Authority
questions.question: Which word describes a state of total disorder resulting from the complete absence or collapse of government authority?
questions.explanation: Greek 'an-' (without) + 'arkhos' (ruler) se 'Anarchy' banta hai, jiska matlab shasan ya kanoon ka abhav (arajakta) hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question:
Select the correct term for:
"A large enclosure, cage, or building specifically constructed for keeping birds."
questions.explanation: Rule RC-03 ke anusaar, Latin root 'avis' (bird) se 'Aviary' banta hai. Apiary madhumakkhiyon (bees) ke liye hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Spatial Enclosure Law: Place vs Occupant vs Activity.

questions.question: What is a military facility where weapons, ammunition, and defense equipment are stored or manufactured called?
questions.explanation: Shastron aur hathiyaron ke sangrah sthan ko 'Arsenal' kehte hain. Mint mein sikke bante hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Spatial Enclosure Law: Place vs Occupant vs Activity.

questions.question:
Identify the word for:
"A facility where the coins of a country are officially manufactured or struck under state authority."
questions.explanation: Taksal, jahan aupacharik sarkari sikke banaye jate hain, use 'Mint' kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Spatial Enclosure Law: Place vs Occupant vs Activity.

questions.question:
Choose the one-word substitution for:
"A storehouse or facility specially constructed for storing threshed grain."
questions.explanation: Anaj store karne ke bhandar ko 'Granary' (annagar) kehte hain. Tannery mein chamda process hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Spatial Enclosure Law: Place vs Occupant vs Activity.

questions.question: What is the term for a book, document, or piece of music written by hand before printing?
questions.explanation: Latin 'manu' (by hand) + 'scriptum' (written) se 'Manuscript' banta hai, jiska matlab pandulipi hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question:
Identify the word that means:
"The dishonest practice of taking someone else's work, ideas, or words and passing them off as one's own."
questions.explanation: Kisi doosre ke sahityik ya bauddhika karya ko chura kar apna batane ko 'Plagiarism' (sahityik chori) kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question:
Select the correct term for:
"A person who held an official position or office immediately before the current incumbent."
questions.explanation: Rule RC-08 ke anusaar, pehle aane wale padadhikari ko 'Predecessor' kehte hain. Baad mein aane wale ko 'Successor' kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Sequence Directionality: Predecessor vs Successor.

questions.subtopic: Time: Lasting for a Fleeting Duration
questions.question:
What is the single-word substitution for:
"Lasting for a very short, fleeting period of time; transitory?"
questions.explanation: Kshanbhangur ya behad kam samay tak tikne wali cheez ko 'Ephemeral' kehte hain. Perpetual aur Eternal lagatar anant kaal tak chalte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question:
Choose the word that means:
"Handwriting or print that is impossible or extremely difficult to read."
questions.explanation: Apathaniya (unreadable) text ko 'Illegible' kehte hain. Eligible yogyata ko batata hai; Inaudible suna na ja sakne wala.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: Which word describes something that is no longer in use because newer alternatives have superseded it?
questions.explanation: Aprachalit vastu jo naye vikalpon ke aane se band ho gayi ho use 'Obsolete' kehte hain. Living species ke poori tarah khatam hone ko Extinct kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: What is the term for formally giving up one's monarchical throne or supreme royal position?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-11 ke anusaar, rajgaddi ya throne ko formally chhodna 'Abdicate' kahlata hai. Aam claims ya rights chhodna Renounce hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-11: Relinquishing Authority: Abdicate vs Renounce.

questions.question:
Choose the word that means:
"To bring formal criminal proceedings against an accused person in a court of law."
questions.explanation: Court mein kanooni mukadma chalane ko 'Prosecute' kehte hain. Kisi ko durbhavnavash satana ya utpeedan karna 'Persecute' kahlata hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: What is an animal that typically moves on four limbs or feet called?
questions.explanation: Latin 'quad' (four) + 'ped' (foot) se 'Quadruped' (chaupaya) banta hai. Do taango par chalne wale ko 'Biped' kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.
